listing.name: League of Geeks (EN Translation)
listing.summary: Enjoy a rough G Translate / DeepL translation version of the League of Geeks provided by one of the CN Authors.

description:
Enjoy a rough G Translate / DeepL translation version of the League of Geeks provided by one of the CN Authors. 

Energy focused faction & rebel subfaction.
A few missions + some MagicLib bounties
Lots of sparkles & revolves around crystals.
Unique upgrading system somewhere (Needs further testing)
Crystal beams; crystal missiles & mechas.

Please feel free to tag if something is acting up
